score_rationales.value_capture: QNT’s value capture is primarily indirect: Overledger licenses and gateway usage are settled via the Treasury model that purchases and locks QNT for fixed periods, reducing circulating supply but not distributing protocol cash flows to holders. There is no widely documented recurring burn program, buyback-to-holder mechanism, or transparent on-chain real yield net of issuance, so holder accrual is weaker than fee-sharing DeFi tokens and major burn-driven L1s.
